messages.subject: Build on Windows. Build email moved.
parts:
Hi all,

We are finally able to get most of Stan built on Windows. We are using
g++ 4.6.1 that can be found here: http://tdm-gcc.tdragon.net/.

This version of g++ cannot build the graphical model parser. demo/gm
can be built using Visual Studio C++ 2010 Express edition (32 bit
only).

This version of g++ cannot build these tests currently:
- agrad/matrix
- gm/parser
- agrad/distributions/inv_wishart
- agrad/distributions/wishart
- agrad/distributions/multi_normal

The Jenkins emails have moved to a new google groups email list. Visit
this page if you want to sign up for those emails:
http://groups.google.com/group/stan-buildbot


Daniel
